sources.title: EXAONE 3.5: Series of Large Language Models for Real-world Use Cases
sources.snippet: Abstract This technical report introduces the EXAONE 3.5 instruction-tuned language models, developed and released by LG AI Research. The EXAONE 3.5 language models are offered in three configurations: 32B, 7.8B, and 2.4B. sources.title: Exeaon · GitHub
sources.snippet: EXEAON Frontier models on the hardware you already own. At batch one, a language model reads every weight from memory to produce a single token. Arithmetic intensity is about 0.5 FLOP per byte, so generation speed is bandwidth divided by model size and the accelerator's FLOP rating never enters the equation.
